title: Rabba manzoor karey
body:
Rabba manzoor karey
Asgar ne teer jhalke baatil ku hai mitaaya (2)
Teen din di pyaas de wich maasoom muskuraaya.....
Rabba manzoor karey meda chey maah da mehmaan, Chey maah da mehmaan, itta deen to jo qurbaan, akhiye naatiq quraan.....
1) jada jhoola rehgaya khaali ye jada ummadi laad lagaaye aa, Jada choley wenjey sughra nu jede hen maasoom de waaye aa, Kidhe sughra nu armaan, itta deen ko jo qurbaan, akhiye naatiq quraan.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2) jeda naane laal me ki taasir oo waada tod nibhaa waanda, My waarke sab kuch deen utto naane da deen bachaa waanda, Asgar aaqri jaan, itta deen to jo rurbaan, akhiye naatoq quraan.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3) khaa teer zulam da wich gal tey jeda duniya ku muu mod gaya, Jeda paani key nai sagda hey pyasa eesawa tod gaya, Kul da kul saamaan, itta deen to jo qurbaan, akhiye naatiq quraan......
<<DIVIDER>>
4) wich qaimey diss maasoom diyaa amdi ne takdiya raawande, Jede laad ladaawan di qaatir payya dass diyaa tak diyaa haawande, Wass amdii di jaan, itta deen to jo qurbaan, akhiye naatiq quraan......
<<DIVIDER>>
5) qursheed rubaab da wich maqtal deene islaam bachaa gayaye, Imraan da qoon ali asgar karke inj sabr wasaa gayaye, Howey ambiyaa hairaan, itta deen to jo qurbaan, akhiye naatiq quraan........
